title: Morphbench - Mesh Morph and Collider Workbench
summary: Inspect Skyrim NIF meshes, TRI morphs, mesh bounds and skeleton collision capsules outside the game. Includes a browser viewer, CLI and local HTTP API. Self-contained Windows x64 tool.
author: Vhodnoylogin
gameSelectionReason: Saved in Skyrim Special Edition / Utilities; the current runtime comparison is Skyrim VR.
tagNote: These exact labels are saved on Nexus. AI Media includes the conceptual image_gen cover and assisted description. The six model screenshots are authentic unretouched tool captures.

mainFile.name: Morphbench 0.7.1 - Windows x64
mainFile.description: Self-contained Windows x64 workbench. Python, NumPy, Pillow and required PyNifly components included. Extract to a tools folder; add morphbench.exe to MO2 to browse merged Data. English and Russian documentation included.

optionalRequirementNotes.Mod Organizer 2: Only for browsing MO2's merged Data folder.
optionalRequirementNotes.BodySlide: Produces meshes and morphs that can be inspected; not required to run Morphbench.
optionalRequirementNotes.PLANCK / HIGGS / Collision Visualizer VR: For reproducing the Skyrim VR game comparison, not for the utility.

permissions.text: Use, modify and redistribute Morphbench under GNU GPL version 3, keeping notices and supplying the required source. Bundled dependencies retain their licences. This grants no rights to third-party models or game assets.

releaseChangeNotes: Includes exclusive output creation, improved morph and bounds checks, capsule coverage corrections and packaging validation.
Human left-thigh x3 diagnostic placement accepted in tool/game comparison.
HTTP documentation explains all=1 on both catalogue and payload requests for meshes without TRI.

quarantine.nextStep: Request moderator review with source and build instructions; keep the original uploaded file. A support email draft is prepared locally but has not been sent.
